newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GA re-brands Asian offices, seen expanding.
newsitem.headline: GA re-brands Asian offices, seen expanding.

text.p: British insurer General Accident plc (GA) said on Wednesday it had consolidated most of its Asian operations under the GA brand name to assist expansion plans.

"A stronger linkage between regional operations and the group will definitely benefit our business in the region," Patrick Wale, Singapore-based GA general manager for Asia told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Wale said GA Asia had doubled its premium income since 1989 and planned to double it again by 2001 from the US$215 million level achieved in 1995.

Including operations in its Asia-Pacific area, adding Australasia, premium income in 1995 was about US$700 million, Wale said. The division of Asia and Asia-Pacific operations took place in March "to give us a better focus in Asia, where as a group we see great potential," he added.
GA has 170 offices in Asia, most of which had been operating under the New Zealand Insurance Co Ltd (NZI) brand since 1989 when GA bought the company.
Operations in New Zealand would probably retain the NZI name where it was the number two player, said Wale.
Wale said the company's growth in Asia would be faster if it was granted underwriting licences in China and India. The company currently has representative offices in both countries.
